title: Facile hydrothermal assembly of WS2–RGO heterostructures guided by chemometrics: a green electrochemical strategy for ceftriaxone surveillance in livestock
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00059B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Minh Quang, Do Mai Nguyen, Vo Chau Ngoc Anh, Dinh Tuan, Tran Thanh Tam Toan, Anh-Quang Dao
A green WS2–RGO electrochemical sensor, optimized via chemometrics, enables highly sensitive detection of ceftriaxone. Achieving an ultralow LOD of 0.009 µM, it provides a robust tool for antibiotic surveillance in livestock.
